task: Implement Phase 3 certificate activation and provisioning
acceptanceCriteria: KMS emits a constrained canonical relay CSR and never exposes a generic signing oracle
one-shot enrollment handles bind the exact live supervisor and invalidate on replay, transfer, wrong order, or restart mismatch
active and pending lifecycle state stages and commits atomically while cleanup and recovery fail closed
the development enrollment key remains Silo-contained and is derived with a fresh nonce bound to its generation
service-net validates bounded TLS 1.3 profiles, manifests, certificate DER, clientAuth EKU, NodeId, SPKI, chain order, and duplicates
missing protected persistence, authenticated time, or authenticated pending-key binding keeps relay mTLS unavailable
production tooling remains fail-closed until Phases 6-8 select, implement, and qualify an exact hardware provider
independent OpenSSL verification and final code/security re-reviews return GO for the Phase 3 software contract
publicContracts: append-only KMS opcodes 9-14 and errors 22-26 retain their frozen numeric values
certificate chains and private key material never cross KMS frames
CSR input is a frozen profile reconstructed by KMS and provider, not a caller body or digest
opcode 14 exposes only active public metadata and cannot authorize precommit pending-key activation
production runtime stays sealed without protected persistence and authenticated time
blastRadius: KMS lifecycle recovery and provider cleanup
relay manifest tooling and production exclusion
scoutSummary: Phase 3 closes the constrained CSR, lifecycle, Silo enrollment-key, and strict validation software seams while preserving unavailable runtime and production states where protected dependencies do not exist.
